description: This Java source file defines the SynthEngine class, a polyphonic, single-channel MIDI synthesizer engine that processes MIDI events and produces audio output. It includes nested classes for MIDI message handling and the synthesis loop, manages multiple voices, and interfaces with audio hardware.
external_methods: MidiConstants.isAllActiveSensing(byte[] data, int offset, int count)

classes.name: SynthEngine
classes.description: The main class implementing a polyphonic MIDI synthesizer engine, managing MIDI event processing, voice management, and audio output.

classes.name: SynthEngine.MyReceiver
classes.description: Nested class handling incoming MIDI messages and dispatching note, pitch bend, and program change events.

classes.name: SynthEngine.MyRunnable
classes.description: Nested class representing the background thread responsible for audio synthesis, processing MIDI events, generating audio buffers, and sending to output.

methods.name: onSend
methods.description: Receives MIDI messages and forwards them to the MIDI event scheduler.

methods.name: onLoopStarted
methods.description: Hook called before the synthesis loop starts; can be overridden for initialization.

methods.name: onBufferCompleted
methods.description: Hook called after each buffer is generated; can be overridden for processing.

methods.name: onLoopEnded
methods.description: Hook called when the synthesis thread stops; can be overridden for cleanup.

methods.name: logMidiMessage
methods.description: Logs received MIDI messages for debugging.

methods.name: processMidiEvents
methods.description: Retrieves and dispatches MIDI events scheduled for current time.

methods.name: generateBuffer
methods.description: Mixes active voices into the audio buffer for output.

methods.name: noteOff
methods.description: Handles note-off MIDI messages, stopping the corresponding voice.

methods.name: createVoice
methods.description: Creates a new SynthVoice instance based on the current program.

methods.name: noteOn
methods.description: Handles note-on MIDI messages, starting or retriggering voices.

methods.name: pitchBend
methods.description: Adjusts pitch bend for all active voices based on MIDI value.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the synthesis thread and initializes MIDI event scheduler.
